The evidence highlights a recurring role of the hemagglutinin antigen as a bridge between Magnesium levulinate and the receptor, suggesting a potential mechanism involving viral protein interaction or enzymatic activity. The integration of these pathways provides a concise, mechanistic link that aligns with the observed scores, offering a streamlined explanation for the relationship.
